about.heading: About the Event
about.body: TEDxAlFalah Youth is an independently organized TED event, designed especially for young men and women in the United Arab Emirates. This event aims to inspire young minds by providing them with a platform to share their ideas, stories, and passions. We believe that the voice of youth is the voice of the future, and that great ideas start with small steps. This event serves youth of all ages and backgrounds, fostering creativity, critical thinking, and collaboration.

item1.question: Who is eligible to apply as a young speaker?
item1.answer: The young speaker track is open to anyone aged 10 to 18, regardless of nationality or background. We're looking for young people with an original idea, an inspiring personal story, or a unique vision worth sharing on the TEDx stage. No prior public speaking experience is required—just passion and a willingness to grow.

item2.question: Who is eligible to apply as an expert?
item2.answer: The expert track is for adults (18+) who work in fields related to children and youth, such as education, mental health, technology, social innovation, and the arts. We welcome experts with a powerful story or groundbreaking research that can inspire the next generation.

item3.question: What language should the talk be in?
item3.answer: Talks can be delivered in either Arabic or English. If the talk is in a language not understood by the entire audience, we may provide on-screen subtitles to ensure the idea reaches everyone. What matters most is the clarity of the message and its ability to inspire.

item4.question: Will I receive coaching support?
item4.answer: Yes, all selected speakers receive a tailored coaching program that includes multiple one-on-one and group sessions with professional speaking coaches and content developers. We'll help you transform your idea into a compelling TEDx talk, from structure to body language and stage rehearsal.

item5.question: What is the time commitment if I am selected?
item5.answer: Selected speakers should expect to dedicate about 4–6 hours per week over 6–8 weeks before the event. This includes coaching sessions, content writing, and rehearsals. The week before the event, hours increase slightly for final on-stage rehearsals. On event day, you'll need to be present from morning until the event concludes in the evening.

section1.title: 1. Application Terms
content: By submitting an application to speak at TEDxAlFalah Youth, you confirm that all provided information is accurate and true to the best of your knowledge.

Applications submitted under the young speaker track (ages 10–14) require explicit guardian consent, given via the checkbox in the application form. The organizing team may contact the guardian directly to verify this consent before proceeding.

By submitting your talk idea, summary, and any attached video, you grant TEDxAlFalah Youth a non-exclusive license to review, discuss internally, and — if selected — develop it with you for the event. You retain ownership of your ideas and original content.
All selection decisions made by the review committee are final. As stated on the application page, not being selected reflects limited slots, not a judgment on your story's worth.

TEDxAlFalah Youth reserves the right to adjust the application timeline, including extending or closing the application window before the announced date; any changes will be communicated via this website.

section2.title: 2. Ticket Terms
content: Tickets are issued in the buyer's name and are non-transferable unless arranged with the organizing team in advance.
Refund requests must be submitted via email to marhaba@tedxalfalahyouth.com no later than 7 days before the event date. Refunds are not guaranteed after this period.
TEDxAlFalah Youth reserves the right to deny entry or cancel a ticket in cases of security concerns, capacity limits, or violation of these terms.
If the event is postponed or canceled, ticket holders will be notified via the email provided at purchase/registration, and options for refund or compensation will be communicated at that time.

section3.title: 3. Photography & Recording Consent
content: Photography, video, and audio recording will take place throughout TEDxAlFalah Youth for archival, promotional, and TED license compliance purposes.

By attending the event or submitting an application to speak, you (or your guardian for applicants under 18) consent to being photographed and/or recorded and to the use of such media on the TEDxAlFalah Youth website, social media platforms, and TED global platforms under the terms of the TEDx license.

If you do not wish to be photographed or recorded, please inform a member of the event team upon arrival to make appropriate arrangements where possible; however, complete exclusion from all recorded areas (such as the main hall during talks) may not always be feasible.
Speaker talks are recorded and may be publicly published (including on YouTube via the TEDx program) after the event, in accordance with standard TEDx license requirements.

section4.title: 4. Privacy Policy
content: This section explains the personal data TEDxAlFalah Youth collects via this website, why we collect it, how it is stored, and the rights you have over it. We give special care to data concerning children (ages 10–14) submitted through the young speaker application track.

**What We Collect.** Depending on the form you use, we may collect: full name, age, email, phone number, city, school name (young speaker track only), guardian name and contact details (young speaker track only), organization and role (expert track only), talk idea details, and any message you send us via the contact or partnership form. For ticket purchases, payment is processed directly by Stripe — we do not receive or store your full card details.

**Why We Collect It.** We use this information solely to: evaluate speaker applications, communicate with applicants and their guardians about the selection process, process ticket registrations and send event-day information, respond to inquiries, and coordinate with potential partners/sponsors.

**Children's Data.** For applicants under 18, we collect guardian contact details specifically so consent can be verified and so the organizing team communicates with the guardian throughout the process, not the child alone. We do not use children's data for any purpose beyond event organization, nor do we share it with third parties for marketing purposes.

**Where Your Data Is Stored.** Application and registration data is stored in Google Sheets, accessible only to members of the TEDxAlFalah Youth organizing and review team. Public content on this site (speakers, team, sponsors, schedule) is managed via Sanity, a third-party content management platform. Email communication is sent via Resend. Ticket payments, when applicable, are processed by Stripe. Each of these providers has its own privacy and security practices as independent data processors.

**Retention Period.** We retain application data for 12 months after the event for record-keeping and future edition planning, after which it is deleted upon request or as part of routine data hygiene. You can request early deletion at any time (see 'Your Rights' below).

**Your Rights.** You (or the guardian for a minor's data) can request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal data we hold about you by emailing marhaba@tedxalfalahyouth.com. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe and in accordance with applicable UAE data protection law.

**Security.** We restrict access to application data to authorized organizing team members only and rely on the security practices of our external providers (Google, Sanity, Resend, Stripe) for data in transit and at rest.
**Cookies.** This site does not use tracking or advertising cookies.
**Contact.** Questions about this privacy policy or your data can be directed to marhaba@tedxalfalahyouth.com.

section5.title: 5. TEDx License Acknowledgment
content: TEDxAlFalah Youth is independently organized and operated under a free license from TED, in line with the TEDx program's mission of discovering and spreading great ideas within local communities.

This event is not officially affiliated with, sponsored by, or organized by TED or TEDx staff beyond the standard TEDx license terms. All content, speaker selection, and event operations are the sole responsibility of the independent TEDxAlFalah Youth organizing team.
Speaker talks may be submitted to TED for potential inclusion on the official TEDx YouTube channel, in accordance with standard TEDx content guidelines, at the discretion of the TEDx program.

section6.title: 6. Liability & General Terms
content: TEDxAlFalah Youth, its organizers, and volunteers make reasonable efforts to ensure a safe and well-run event but do not accept liability for personal injury, loss, or property damage during the event, except where required by applicable law.

Attendees and applicants participate at their own risk. Parents of young speaker applicants remain responsible for their children's care while under their own supervision before and after any scheduled coaching sessions, rehearsals, or the event day, unless explicitly arranged with the organizing team.
These terms are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates. Any disputes arising from these terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Dubai.

TEDxAlFalah Youth reserves the right to update these terms and conditions and privacy policy from time to time. The latest version will always be available on this page, with the effective date below.
